figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Growth of Bacillus atrophaeus in modified ISP-4 medium,
along with levels of bacillamide A (1), bacillamide C (2), and N-
acetyltryptamine (3). Growth was assessed by measuring optical
density, while compound concentrations were determined by
measuring peak areas in HPLC analysis and comparing them with
standards (Supporting Information).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. HPLC chromatograms (DAD 230 nm) of (A) control culture and cultures with (B) 4-, (C) 5-, and (D) 6-fluoro-tryptophan added. Peaks
were identified in crude extract by LC-MS as N-acetyltryptamine (9.3 min, 3); 4-, 5-, and 6-fluoro-N-acetyltryptamine (9.8 min, 4−6, respectively);
bacillamide C (10.1 min, 2); 4-, 5-, and 6-fluoro-bacillamide C (10.3 min, 8−10, respectively); bacillamide A (12.3 min, 1); 4-, 5-, and 6-fluoro-
bacillamide A (12.5 min, 11−13, respectively). HRMS values are shown for each identified peak.
